atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
rangeLen = input(20, "Range Coil Length", 5, 100, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "Vol-of-Vol Length", 5, 100, 1)
coilThresh = input(0.25, "Coil Threshold", 0.05, 0.6, 0.01)
predLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 100, 1)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Multiplier", 1.0, 4.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr = max(high - low, max(abs(high - close[1]), abs(low - close[1])))
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
barRng = high - low
lowestRng = lowest(barRng, rangeLen)
highestRng = highest(barRng, rangeLen)
rangeLoad = lowestRng / max(highestRng, 0.000000001)
highestAtr = highest(atrVal, rangeLen)
atrLoad = atrVal / max(highestAtr, 0.000000001)
combined = (rangeLoad + atrLoad) / 2
loadedness = 1 - combined
atrSma = sma(atrVal, vovLen)
atrSd = stdev(atrVal, vovLen)
vov = atrSd / max(atrSma, 0.000000001)
vovRising = vov > vov[1] and vov[1] > vov[2] and vov[2] > vov[3]
sumRng = sma(barRng, predLen) * predLen
predictability = abs(close - close[predLen]) / max(sumRng, 0.000000001)
releaseEnergy = barRng / max(atrVal[1], 0.000000001)
loadThresh = 1 - coilThresh
isPredictable = predictability > 0.3
buyCond = loadedness > loadThresh and vovRising and releaseEnergy > releaseMult and close > open
sellCond = loadedness > loadThresh and vovRising and releaseEnergy > releaseMult and close < open
buySig = buyCond and not buyCond[1]
sellSig = sellCond and not sellCond[1]
predBuy = buySig and isPredictable
unpredBuy = buySig and not isPredictable
predSell = sellSig and isPredictable
unpredSell = sellSig and not isPredictable

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if predBuy {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Pred Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.2 * markerSize, 2, "separate")
}
if unpredBuy {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Unpred Buy", "coneup", "#ffd43b", 0.9 * markerSize, 2, "separate")
}
if predSell {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Pred Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.2 * markerSize, 2, "separate")
}
if unpredSell {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Unpred Sell", "conedown", "#b48cff", 0.9 * markerSize, 2, "separate")
}

plot(loadedness, "Loadedness", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(predictability, "Predictability", "#b48cff", 1, "separate")
hline(loadThresh, "#22aaff", "separate")
hline(0.3, "#b48cff", "separate")
bgcolor(vovRising ? "#2a2440" : "#101020", "separate")
plot3d(loadedness, "Loadedness", "surface", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predictability, "Predictability", "ribbon", "#b48cff", "separate", 1)

fastLen = input(10, "Fast Horizon", 5, 20, 1)
medLen = input(30, "Medium Horizon", 15, 50, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow Horizon", 30, 100, 1)
skewLen = input(60, "Skew Range Length", 20, 120, 1)
compLb = input(50, "Compression Lookback", 20, 100, 1)
expMult = input(1.15, "Expansion Mult", 1.0, 2.0, 0.05)
skewThresh = input(0.2, "Skew Flip Threshold", 0.05, 0.8, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

denom = close[1] + 0.000000001
r = (close - close[1]) / denom
ann = sqrt(252)
fastVol = stdev(r, fastLen) * ann
medVol = stdev(r, medLen) * ann
slowVol = stdev(r, slowLen) * ann
hiR = highest(high, skewLen)
loR = lowest(low, skewLen)
rng = hiR - loR + 0.000000001
skew = (close - loR) / rng * 2 - 1
spread = fastVol - slowVol
slopeMid = medVol - slowVol
coilLow = lowest(fastVol, compLb)
isLowest = fastVol <= medVol and fastVol <= slowVol
compressed = isLowest and fastVol <= coilLow * 1.02
expLine = medVol * expMult
expLinePrev = medVol[1] * expMult
expandCross = fastVol > expLine and fastVol[1] <= expLinePrev
breakHigh = compressed[1] and fastVol > fastVol[1] and fastVol > coilLow[1]
expansionNow = expandCross or breakHigh
negThresh = 0 - skewThresh
skewBullFlip = skew > skewThresh and skew[1] <= skewThresh
skewBearFlip = skew < negThresh and skew[1] >= negThresh
spreadUp = spread > spread[1] and spread[1] <= 0
spreadDown = spread < spread[1] and spread[1] >= 0
termAvg = (fastVol + medVol + slowVol) / 3
impulse = fastVol + spread * skew + slopeMid * 0.2

var lastSig = -100
buyRaw = compressed[1] and expansionNow and skewBullFlip and spreadUp
sellRaw = compressed[1] and expansionNow and skewBearFlip and spreadDown
coolOk = bar_index - lastSig > 10
buySig = buyRaw and coolOk
sellSig = sellRaw and coolOk

if buySig {
lastSig := bar_index
}
if sellSig {
lastSig := bar_index
}
if buySig {
plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy 3D", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 1, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell 3D", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "separate")
}

plot(spread, "Spread Fast-Slow", "#22cc88", 2, "separate")
plot(skew, "Skew", "#ffaa00", 1, "separate")
plot(slopeMid, "SlopeMid Med-Slow", "#4488ff", 1, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")
plot3d(termAvg, "Term Manifold", "manifold", "#22cc88", "separate", 0)
plot3d(fastVol, "Front Spine", "ribbon", "#ffaa00", "separate", 1)
plot3d(impulse, "Impulse", "bars3d", "#aa66ff", "separate", 2)

h5 = (c5 / 100.0) * maxHeight

dxBar = close - open

dzBar = close - close[1]

vy = wy + dyBar
vz = wz + dzBar
gust = (close - open) * 0.5
spdRaw = windSpeedIn + gust
tmpHi = spdRaw > maxSpd ? maxSpd : spdRaw
clampedSpd = tmpHi < minSpd ? minSpd : tmpHi
rng = maxSpd - minSpd + 0.000000001
speedNorm = (clampedSpd - minSpd) / rng
tailLen = baseTail + lenFactor * clampedSpd
mag = sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy + vz * vz + 0.000000001)
nx = vx / mag
ny = vy / mag
nz = vz / mag
yawRaw = nx * 180.0
pitchRaw = nz * 90.0
rollDeg = 0.0
isZero = (vx * vx + vy * vy + vz * vz) < 0.000000001

var yawHold = 0.0
var pitchHold = 0.0
var lastFire = -10000.0

if isZero {
} else {

    pitchHold := pitchRaw
}

pitchDeg = isZero ? pitchHold : pitchRaw
highThresh = 0.8 * maxSpd
lowThresh = minSpd + 0.2 * (maxSpd - minSpd)
prevSpd = clampedSpd[1]
prevYaw = yawDeg[1]
prevPitch = pitchDeg[1]
highState = clampedSpd > highThresh
lowState = clampedSpd < lowThresh
yawChg = abs(yawDeg - prevYaw)
pitchChg = abs(pitchDeg - prevPitch)
shiftCond = yawChg > 30 or pitchChg > 30
highEvt = highState and not highState[1]
calmEvt = lowState and not lowState[1]
shiftEvt = shiftCond and not shiftCond[1]
coolOk = bar_index - lastFire[1] >= 8
highSig = highEvt and coolOk
calmSig = calmEvt and coolOk
shiftSig = shiftEvt and coolOk and not highEvt and not calmEvt
buySig = calmSig
sellSig = highSig or shiftSig
fireAny = highSig or calmSig or shiftSig
if fireAny {

}
arrowColor = speedNorm > 0.75 ? "#ff7b1a" : speedNorm > 0.5 ? "#b87a3a" : speedNorm > 0.25 ? "#6b8fd1" : "#2a7fff"
coneSize = 0.6 + speedNorm * 1.4
coneSizeS = coneSize * markerSize
